target.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users generating music through OpenRouter could configure provider request policy, such as custom headers or proxy settings, but the OpenRouter music generation HTTP request ignored that policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The OpenRouter music provider now sanitizes `cfg.models.providers.openrouter.request` and passes it into the existing provider HTTP resolver for the music generation request path. The change stays limited to music generation request configuration and leaves model selection, streaming, timeout, and response parsing behavior unchanged.

## User Impact

Users who rely on provider-level request settings can expect OpenRouter music generation to honor the same configured transport policy as the other OpenRouter media path. Default behavior is unchanged when no request policy is configured.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.test.ts` passed: 14 tests.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --engine claude --model claude-fable-5 --thinking high` reported no accepted/actionable findings.

### 2026-07-12 follow-up: exact-head local provider-path proof

- Exact PR head verified locally: `cfa01f26006397c224945e634965d354d1803792`.
- Command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.test.ts`.
- Result: passed 1 Vitest shard in 52.57s; 14 tests passed.
- The focused regression covers the changed OpenRouter music generation request path and verifies the configured provider request policy is passed into the HTTP resolver for music generation.
- This is controlled local provider-path proof only. No live OpenRouter API call was made, and no real OpenRouter account, proxy, or generated music artifact was exercised.

## Proof

### 2026-07-12 follow-up: local real-transport proof for music request policy

- Exact head tested and pushed: `fb4b0c2e164376f3bb78717d1a3cf8d3bb9a7b36`.
- Code correction from the new proof: removed the hard-coded `allowPrivateNetwork: false` that overrode `models.providers.openrouter.request.allowPrivateNetwork` on the OpenRouter music path.
- Local controlled transport harness added: `extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.transport.test.ts` starts a local HTTP server, calls `buildOpenRouterMusicGenerationProvider().generateMusic()`, uses the real provider HTTP transport/SSRF/request-policy path, and verifies the configured `X-OpenRouter-Trace` header reaches the server while the SSE response produces an audio track.
- Commands run:

  ```bash
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.transport.test.ts --reporter=verbose
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.transport.test.ts extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.test.ts
  git diff --check
  ```

- Results: PASS: transport test 1/1 in 12.75s; focused OpenRouter music suite 2 files / 15 tests in 26.39s; `git diff --check` passed.
- Observation: this is stronger than the previous mock-only resolver proof because it exercises real local HTTP transport and proves the configured request header reaches the server through the provider path.
- Not tested: this is still not a live OpenRouter API call. No real OpenRouter account, external proxy, or external provider music generation endpoint was exercised.


### 2026-07-12 current-head local proof after update-branch

- Exact head tested: `ff819e2a7dc47fe0b268083f473b16dec9c4bf2d`
- Scope: Controlled local provider-path proof for OpenRouter music generation after the current `main` merge. This exercises the real provider HTTP transport path against a local HTTP server, with `allowPrivateNetwork: true` and a configured request header reaching the endpoint. It also runs the existing mocked provider policy unit coverage in the same command to guard against mock contamination.
- Commands:

  ```bash
  git fetch fork alix/openrouter-request-policy-music-generation && git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
  git diff --check
  node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.ts extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.transport.test.ts
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.transport.test.ts extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.test.ts
  ```

- Result: PASS: `git diff --check` passed; focused oxlint passed; Vitest passed 1 shard, 2 test files, 15 tests in 40.13s total wall time including local heavy-check lock wait; Vitest duration 22.98s.
- Observation: `extensions/openrouter/music-generation-provider.transport.test.ts` starts a local HTTP server and verifies the real `buildOpenRouterMusicGenerationProvider().generateMusic(...)` path sends the configured request header through the provider HTTP layer when private-network access is explicitly enabled, then receives and decodes the streamed audio response. The companion provider test continues to cover request-policy wiring without relying on the transport harness.
- Not tested: No live OpenRouter API request, real API key, proxy, or external provider endpoint was exercised.
